method: Read the assigned input and both rubrics, then viewed all four reference images first and all forty candidate PNGs individually with view_image detail original, in the supplied candidate and capture order. Judged the actual displayed pixels of each size pair, with 9 reserved for the same painted hand as the references. No source, metadata, prior reviews, browser, network, or other candidates were consulted. Large typography and physical scrolling boundaries were treated as intentional. Preview banners and unchanged combat room, actor, and hand art were excluded from comparative preference. Animated label brightness and actor poses were not treated as stable differences; no interaction or lifetime claims are made. Combat scores are tied because the visible plaque treatment does not support a reliable material preference; its required ranking uses input order for that tie.

rest.worst_problem: The right choice frames have broad, softly glowing rectangular surrounds whose light is less physically specific than the carved portrait frame at left.

size_notes.1600x900: The fort painting, its candlelit plinth, and the three visible choices form a clear two-part composition. Pillow seams read, but choice corners and straight rims are very fine against broad ambient highlights; the lower rail has visible joints but a soft face.
size_notes.1280x800: Text remains clear and the third choice passes behind the labeled lower edge. The illustration retains its focus, while the smooth title lettering and low-contrast broad choice surrounds still fall short of the reference's chipped carved surfaces.

winner_fixes: Combat-floaters: give the upper condition plaques visible narrow side returns, worn gold catches, and dark contact edges; preserve the readable signed words and local owner labels.

Rest, event, gameover, and shop: paint irregular lavender letter planes, small edge chips, and selective warm reflections into the main title letters so their finish matches the reference title rather than a uniform bevel.
Rest: replace the broad even halos around the right choice frames with localized candle-facing highlights and distinct darker lower and side planes, preserving all current text.
Gameover: make the right Final Tricks rows into shallow worn enamel plaques with visible edge thickness and locally varied gold light, retaining the complete memorial hierarchy and continuation edge.
Event: sharpen the physical paper overlap immediately above the lower rail with a narrow contact shadow and small irregular paper edge details; keep the large copy and below-rail continuation.
Shop: vary the top and side light on the card rims and add restrained wear at the corners so the cards share the merchant frame's painted finish.
Shop and combat-floaters: replace the flat shield silhouettes and simple icon fills with small painted relief or enamel treatments consistent with the moon and paw medallions.
Event: give the window light more broken, painted falloff on the wall, lectern, and floor so the beams do not read as soft translucent cones.
Rest: add specific wall molding, damask variation, and candle-directed highlights in the broad middle wall field so the room has the reference paintings' spatial specificity.

grafts.idea: Use the pillow medallion's clearly visible crossing seams and tuft detail while retaining IOLITE's frame and rail treatment.

Borrow the subtle shadowed carved relief from the register rail in a few small inset areas of IOLITE's rail face, retaining IOLITE's restrained top lip and end construction rather than repeating arches across the full width.
